gaps.sentence: She's having her wedding dress ___ by a tailor in Naples.
gaps.explanation: Have + object + past participle: having her dress made by a professional.

gaps.sentence: Your name ___ (find) anywhere on the guest list, I'm afraid.
gaps.explanation: Modal passive of ability/possibility: cannot be + past participle.

gaps.sentence: The manuscript ___ (BELIEVE) to be the composer’s last work.
gaps.explanation: 'People believe it is…' becomes 'it is believed to be…'.

gaps.sentence: Your luggage ___ (weigh) at check-in, so allow extra time.
gaps.explanation: Future simple passive: will be + weighed. The agent (staff) is obvious.

gaps.sentence: By the time you read this, the treaty ___ (sign) by all twelve delegations.
gaps.explanation: 'By the time + present clause' with a future meaning takes the future perfect passive.

gaps.sentence: The bridge ___ by a locally trained architect.
gaps.explanation: 'Was designed by' — passive with the agent in a by-phrase.

gaps.sentence: By next June, the entire collection ___ (move) to the new wing.
gaps.explanation: Future perfect passive: will have been + past participle for something finished by 'next June'.

gaps.sentence: Did you have the brakes ___ (check) before the long drive?
gaps.hint: question form of have something done
gaps.explanation: Causative question: Did you have + the brakes + checked? A mechanic did the checking.
